text: Planting seeds requires more than mere sowing; the gardener must also manage the earth beneath them and feed the growing crops. Mulching serves one purpose: keeping water in the ground while choking out unwanted weeds. Composting fulfills a second role, returning lost nutrients to the dirt so vegetation can flourish. Success depends on balancing effort with precision. When these two techniques are applied correctly, the result is a vibrant garden that enriches its surroundings with color and vitality.
